:::{#exr-unbiased-exp}
#### Expected value of an unbiased estimator

Using @thm-bias-exprs,
find $\E{\hth}$ for an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator $\hth$ of $\th$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::::{.solution}

$$
\begin{aligned}
0 &= \bias{\hth}
&& \text{(definition of unbiased)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \th
&& \text{(bias equals expectation minus truth)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding $\th$ to both sides gives $\E{\hth} = \th$.

::::
